Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — Verdant Labs renewal in 4 business days. They want to shorten from 12mo -> 9mo, add 12 seats, and require separate invoices for EU ops + US entity. Asking if their onboarding credit can be prorated and split across invoices. Any blockers?
Ethan (Sales): If we keep unit price same for 9mo that's preferred. Procurement needs two POs. Could slow signing.
Maya (CS): Customer insists on two invoices for internal chargebacks. Also asked that enablement happen within 21 days of signature.
Priya (Legal): Separate invoices ok. I'll draft a short amendment: term change, seat add, and "onboarding credit to be allocated pro rata across issued invoices unless otherwise specified by customer." Need exact legal names and VAT IDs.
Omar (Billing): We can split a one-time credit pro rata at invoicing, but need vendor codes + billing emails. EU invoice needs VAT handling — confirm if they're VAT-registered.
LMS Bot: Draft invoice preview:
```
INVOICE PREVIEW
Verdant EU (Entity A) - 7,200 EUR - 8 seats (9mo prorated)
Verdant US (Entity B) - $3,600 USD - 4 seats (9mo prorated)
Onboarding credit: 1,200 (split pro rata)
```
Ethan (Sales): I'll get PO numbers, legal names, VAT IDs today.
Maya (CS): I'll send the go-live checklist and ask for preferred enablement slots. Please note billing needs PO/vendor codes by COB Wed to meet billing run.
Priya (Legal): I'll route the amendment via DocuSign after names/POs confirmed.
Omar (Billing): Once signed I will issue two invoices and apply the pro rata credit. Thanks team :white_check_mark:
